classification.method: curated rewrite aligned with the current HCU three-center architecture and the BRG-0006 → BRG-0007 → BRG-0008 narrative chain
classification.note: The Human Center becomes dominant because the story explicitly defines a relational method based on dignity, consent, responsibility and contestability. Dark remains strongly present through uncertainty, possibility and refusal of a false binary; Light remains present through evidence, order and protection.
